e.title: The European Actuary 第 46 期
e.summary: 欧洲精算师杂志（TEA）第 46 期：欧洲精算行业的专业出版物
e.body:
The European Actuary（TEA）第 46 期：欧洲精算协会（AAE）的专业杂志——欧洲精算行业动态/文章的专业出版物。对 RIAA：欧洲精算的专业杂志——与 [[aae-ai-act-position]]（AAE 监管立场）、[[genai-actuarial-conference]]（欧洲会议）配套：欧洲精算资讯/出版矩阵；阅读欧洲精算的专业文章（行业动态/技术前沿）；英语阅读 + 欧洲精算视野；精算专业阅读清单。

e.summary_hk: 歐洲精算師雜誌（TEA）第 46 期：歐洲精算行業的專業出版物
e.body_en:
The European Actuary (TEA) issue 46: the professional magazine of the Actuarial Association of Europe (AAE) — a professional publication of European actuarial-industry dynamics/articles. For RIAA: the European actuarial professional magazine — with [[aae-ai-act-position]] (AAE regulatory stance) and [[genai-actuarial-conference]] (European conference) it forms the European actuarial news/publication matrix; read European actuarial professional articles (industry dynamics/technical frontier); English reading + European actuarial perspective; an actuarial professional reading list.
